description: Runs evaluate on a situation and on the same situation with a change, and returns only what differs, rule by rule, with before, after and the difference: dismissal or resignation, a raise, another child, moving a job end date past the one-year mark, more reserve days, a second employer. The change is a partial situation merged into the first (e.g. {"employment": {"end_reason": "resign"}}).

change.description: Fields to change, same shape as the situation (merged into it)

situation.description: The base situation, as in evaluate

as_of.description: Date of the rules to apply (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today in Israel

previous_children.description: Children the mother had before this birth

salary_3_months.description: Gross salary in the 3 months before leave

salary_6_months.description: Gross salary in the 6 months before leave

employers.description: Number of employers at the same time

end.description: End of employment, if it ended or will end (YYYY-MM-DD)

end_reason.description: dismissal, entitled (resignation that entitles to severance) or resign

had_pension_before.description: Had an active pension fund when starting the job

start.description: Start of employment at this employer (YYYY-MM-DD)

parent_role.description: main = the mother or the parent receiving child allowance; other = the other parent

reserve_combat_days_last_year.description: Combat reserve days in the previous year

service.description: Discharged soldier: 0 none, 1 short service, 2 full service

single_parent.description: Single parent (other parent deceased or not registered)

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent from a residential apartment

income_3_months.description: Income in the 3 months before the call-up

monthly_income.description: Monthly taxable income from the business

name: what_if
title: Compare two scenarios for a client (what if)
